Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Replying to Lucia regarding Her Upcoming Trip, Itinerary, and Weather
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your pen pal, Lucia, who is visiting your city next month. Read part of her email below:

"I have just booked my flights to your city next month! I cannot wait to explore and catch up. Could you suggest some enjoyable activities and places we should visit together? What will the weather be like at that time, and what kind of clothes or essentials should I prepare for the trip?"

Write an informal email responding to Lucia.
title: Task 1.1: Replying to Lucia regarding Her Upcoming Trip, Itinerary, and Weather
content:
You have received an email from your pen pal, Lucia, who is visiting your city next month. Read part of her email below:

"I have just booked my flights to your city next month! I cannot wait to explore and catch up. Could you suggest some enjoyable activities and places we should visit together? What will the weather be like at that time, and what kind of clothes or essentials should I prepare for the trip?"

Write an informal email responding to Lucia.

body.answer: We should spend a morning walking around the central lake and historical museum, and then explore the evening food street together.
body.example: For example, on Saturday we can drink iced coffee near the old cathedral, visit a craft market, and have hot Pho for dinner.
body.frame: I am genuinely thrilled to hear that you are planning to visit my hometown! There are two suggestions that I would like to make.
body.reason: Visiting these spots helps us catch up through face-to-face interaction while letting you broaden your mind and taste authentic local dishes like Pho.
body.requirement: Suggest enjoyable activities and places to visit together with Lucia

body.answer: Next month the weather here will be quite warm and sunny during the day, around 28 to 32 degrees Celsius, with occasional short afternoon showers.
body.example: For instance, mornings from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM are usually bright and breezy, which is great for taking photos outdoors.
body.frame: I would like to give you information on ______. / I would like to let you know that ______.
body.reason: Knowing the forecast early helps us plan outdoor walks in the morning and stay indoors at cozy cafes when it rains.
body.requirement: Describe what the weather will be like next month

body.answer: Don't forget to pack light cotton clothes, comfortable walking shoes, sunscreen, and a small folding umbrella.
body.example: For example, wearing breathable T-shirts, sunglasses, and cushioned sneakers will keep you cool and comfortable all day.
body.frame: When it comes to ______, you certainly shouldn't ______. / Also, don't forget to ______.
body.reason: Light outfits and good sneakers are convenient because we will do a lot of walking around town, and an umbrella helps you stay on the safe side during sudden rain.
body.requirement: Advise what kind of clothes or essentials she should prepare for the trip

opening.fill: your upcoming visit, our trip plan, and what to pack for next month

hint.purpose: Reply to Lucia with suggested activities and places to visit together, next month's weather forecast, and packing advice on clothes and essentials.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: The Effects of Reading Habits and Methods to Encourage Reading
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"With the overwhelming rise of short-form digital media, fewer people maintain the habit of reading books. Many educators stress that reading books exercises the brain, expands vocabulary, and deepens emotional empathy."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive effects of cultivating a regular reading habit and proposing feasible measures that schools and families can implement to encourage people, especially the youth, to read more. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
title: Task 2.1: The Effects of Reading Habits and Methods to Encourage Reading
content:
Read the following statement:

"With the overwhelming rise of short-form digital media, fewer people maintain the habit of reading books. Many educators stress that reading books exercises the brain, expands vocabulary, and deepens emotional empathy."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive effects of cultivating a regular reading habit and proposing feasible measures that schools and families can implement to encourage people, especially the youth, to read more. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother reads a printed history book for 30 minutes every night in a quiet room, which helps him relax and do better in his school essays.
body1.focus: Positive effects: Brain exercise, knowledge, and stress relief
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... / Shared Body 1
body1.point: Reading books regularly allows our brain to exercise, broadens our mind with useful vocabulary, and helps us relieve stress away from phone screens.

body2.example: For example, schools can update their libraries with interesting storybooks, and parents can read together with their children before bedtime instead of letting them watch short videos.
body2.focus: Solutions: Actions from schools and families
body2.frame: Secondly, [ld2]... / Solutions (Body Chunk E + Giải pháp A)
body2.point: To solve this problem, schools and families should work closely together to guide young people, create daily reading time, and upgrade libraries with modern facilities.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, reading regularly helps young people exercise their brain and broaden their mind, so schools and parents should take practical steps to build this good habit.

intro.debai: cultivating a regular reading habit among young people
intro.ld1: exercising the brain and broadening knowledge
intro.ld2: encouraging young people through schools and families
